title: Cardamom sugar cookies
subtitle: crisp, roll-and-cut biscuits spiced with ground cardamom
excerpt: Cardamom sugar cookies are crisp, buttery roll-and-cut biscuits spiced with ground cardamom. The cardamom flavour comes through clearly against the sweet butter base without being overpowering. The dough holds its shape well when rolled and cut, making the cookies good for decorating with a simple icing if wanted. They keep crisp for over a week in a tin.
sourceNotes: Cardamom as a baking spice is documented throughout Scandinavia and the Middle East. Cardamom sugar cookies in a roll-and-cut style are common in Finnish and Swedish baking, where cardamom is the dominant spice in many biscuits and breads.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze baked cookies in an airtight container for up to 2 months. Thaw at room temperature.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Keeps in an airtight tin at room temperature for up to 2 weeks.

content.text: Cardamom sugar cookies are crisp, roll-and-cut biscuits where ground cardamom is the main spice. The flavour is floral and warm rather than sharp. The dough is firm enough to roll thin and cut cleanly, and the biscuits hold their shape through baking without spreading.
Beat the softened butter and caster sugar together until pale and fluffy, about 3 minutes. Beat in the egg and vanilla extract.
Sift in the flour, baking powder, and ground cardamom. Mix until a soft dough forms. Divide in half, press each piece flat, wrap, and chill for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 180 degrees C (fan 160 degrees C / gas 4). Line two baking trays with baking paper.
Roll one disc to about 4 to 5 mm thick on a lightly floured surface. Cut into shapes and place on the prepared trays. Re-roll the trimmings. Repeat with the second disc.
Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until just set at the edges. The centres will look pale but firm. Leave on the tray for 5 minutes, then transfer to a rack. They crisp up fully as they cool.

attrs.problem: Cookies spreading and losing their cut shape
attrs.avoid: Avoid skipping the chill time or cutting dough that is still warm from the hands.
attrs.fix: Chill the rolled and cut cookies on the tray for 10 minutes before baking. Cold cookies hold their shape better in the first minutes in the oven.

attrs.avoid: Avoid pre-ground cardamom that has been open for more than 3 months; the volatile oils dissipate quickly.
attrs.fix: Use fresh ground cardamom. For maximum flavour, buy cardamom pods, crack open and remove the seeds, and grind them just before using.
